articles.title: Why this CEO thinks video games make better training data than the internet
articles.summary: When it comes to achieving artificial general intelligence (AGI), large language models just don’t have what it takes. Models like ChatGPT and Claude are great at text, but they’re less skilled at understanding how things actually move through space and time — an essential skill for producing intelligence that generalizes. articles.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to help enterprises build their own AI agents
articles.summary: Founded in 2024, Prime Intellect’s goal is to give organizations capabilities to train their own agentic systems without relying on frontier AI labs.

articles.title: OpenAI releases new voice models for more natural live conversations
articles.summary: OpenAI says its new voice mode can speak and listen at the same time, a key ability for live translation.

articles.title: This startup thinks robotics is about to have its ChatGPT moment
articles.summary: General Intuition is betting millions of hours of video game data can train the foundation models for physical AI, making it easier to build smarter robots with minimal real-world data.

articles.title: Google’s deepfake detector system used to debunk McConnell hoax pic
articles.summary: Earlier this week, a picture seemed to show Kentucky Senator Mitch McConnell covered in tubes in a hospital bed in a state of extreme distress. It turned out to be an AI-generated fake.

articles.title: China Chipmaker CXMT to Launch $4.3 Billion IPO Next Week
